moves.text: Rahu moves from Kumbha into Makara.
moves.until_text: Rahu stays in Makara until 24 June 2028, when it moves into Dhanu.

moves.text: Ketu moves from Simha into Kataka.
moves.until_text: Ketu stays in Kataka until 24 June 2028, when it moves into Mithuna.

moves.text: Rahu leaves your 7th house and enters your 6th house.
moves.from_theme: The 7th house is about partnership and marriage.
moves.to_theme: The 6th house is about daily work and challenges to get through.

moves.text: Ketu leaves your 1st house and enters your 12th house.
moves.from_theme: The 1st house is about yourself and how you begin things.
moves.to_theme: The 12th house is about rest, spending and faraway places.

others.text: Saturn stays in Meena, your 8th house.
Jupiter stays in Simha, your 1st house.

moves.text: Rahu leaves your 4th house and enters your 3rd house.
moves.from_theme: The 4th house is about home and peace of mind.
moves.to_theme: The 3rd house is about effort, courage and siblings.

moves.text: Ketu leaves your 10th house and enters your 9th house.
moves.from_theme: The 10th house is about career and standing.
moves.to_theme: The 9th house is about fortune, teachers and beliefs.

others.text: Saturn stays in Meena, your 5th house.
Jupiter stays in Simha, your 10th house.
